steps.prompt: Think of a time something went wrong. What happened first, next and last?

cards.title: Events instead of evidence
cards.body: In a narrative essay, the body paragraphs tell the true story: events in order, with details of what you saw, heard and felt. The events lead toward the focus (what the story taught or changed).

cards.title: Time words
cards.body: Time words carry the reader through the events: At first, Then, Next, Suddenly, After that, Later, The next morning, Finally. The essay map lists the time words it finds.

cards.title: A narrative body
cards.text: At first, I was having fun watching the pig races alone. Then I turned around and my family was gone. My heart pounded, and the crowd seemed to grow louder. After a deep breath, I walked to a booth and asked for help.
cards.note: Time words in order; a feeling shown with details; an action that leads toward the lesson.

prompts: Which time words did you use? Could the reader follow the order?
Which detail shows a feeling best?
